**Introduction to Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd.**

Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading chemical enterprise specializing in the research, development, production, and sales of cyclodextrin and its derivatives. Located in the Boxing Economic Development Zone, Binzhou, Shandong Province, China, the company leverages advanced biotechnology and chemical engineering to deliver high-quality cyclodextrin products for pharmaceutical, food, cosmetics, and industrial applications.

Established with a commitment to innovation and sustainability, Huike Cyclodextrin Technology has become a trusted name in the global cyclodextrin market. The company’s state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities adhere to strict quality control standards, ensuring that its products meet international regulatory requirements, including ISO, FDA, and EU certifications. With a strong R&D team, the company continuously explores new applications of cyclodextrins, enhancing their functionality in drug delivery, flavor encapsulation, and environmental protection.

As a key player in Shandong’s chemical industry, Huike Cyclodextrin Technology benefits from the region’s robust industrial infrastructure and strategic location, facilitating efficient logistics and supply chain management. The company prioritizes customer satisfaction, offering customized solutions and technical support to partners worldwide. With a vision of becoming a global leader in cyclodextrin technology, Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd. remains dedicated to excellence, innovation, and sustainable development.
